prompt: A bank opened 10 branches in a new city. Accounts opened per branch are 40% below plan, while foot traffic is on plan. Which is the strongest initial hypothesis?

options.text: Accounts per branch are 40% below plan while foot traffic is on plan.
options.feedback: This restates the facts without proposing a cause.

options.text: It could be products, staff training, pricing, competition or branch locations.
options.feedback: This lists several causes without committing to the most likely one.

options.text: Branch staff are poorly trained; retraining them will fix it.
options.feedback: This states a cause as certain before any data has tested it.

options.text: Visitors aren't converting, possibly because the products don't fit local needs.
options.feedback: Right. It commits to a likely cause that fits the facts, and it is testable: I'd compare conversion by product and by customer segment.

explanation: Traffic on plan with accounts below plan means conversion is the gap. The hypothesis names a cause and a test.

distractor_flaws.M.restates_facts: Accounts per branch are 40% below plan while foot traffic is on plan.
distractor_flaws.M.shotgun_hypotheses: It could be products, staff training, pricing, competition or branch locations.
distractor_flaws.M.overconfident_hypothesis: Branch staff are poorly trained; retraining them will fix it.
